meta.title: Coach Mitch Stuber | Football Coaching — North Dakota
meta.description: Professional football coaching at Bowman County High School. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Mitch Stuber
about.title: OC/RBs/WRs/QBs playcaller
about.bio:
Coach Mitch Stuber brings 4 years of experience running the Gun-T system at Bowman County High School. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Stuber is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the Varsity level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Stuber delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: Bowman County High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Gun-T System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Gun-T offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
